stem: Harrow Freight's configuration needs the ID exported by a `data` block named `aws_ami.web` inside another resource's argument. Which reference reaches that value?
rationale: Data source attributes are reached with the data.<TYPE>.<LABEL>.<ATTRIBUTE> syntax. Dropping the leading data. reaches a resource block of that type and label instead, and there is no such resource block here. A variable only holds a value passed in from outside; it isn't automatically populated with a data source's attribute. A local value only holds what its own expression computes, and nothing here assigns the AMI ID to that local.
